mapper.select:
/* 문의사항 엑셀용 전체 목록 조회 (페이징 없음) inq.selectInqExcelList */ SELECT A.INQ_ID , A.TITLE , A.CONTENT , C.CODE_NM AS CAT_NM , G.AGENT_NM , S.CODE_NM AS STATUS_NM , U.USER_NM AS CRTR_NM , DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS CREATE_DT FROM TB_INQ A LEFT JOIN TB_CODE C ON C.CODE_GRP_ID = 'IS000002' AND C.CODE_ID = A.CAT_CD LEFT JOIN TB_CODE S ON S.CODE_GRP_ID = 'IS000001' AND S.CODE_ID = A.STATUS_CD LEFT JOIN TB_AGT G ON G.AGENT_ID = A.AGENT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = A.CRTR_ID WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y'
ORDER BY A.CREATE_DT DESC, A.INQ_ID DESC

/* 문의사항 엑셀용 답변·댓글 전체 조회 (엑셀 목록과 같은 조회 조건) inq.selectInqExcelAnsrList */ SELECT R.INQ_ID , R.ANSR_ID , R.DEPTH , R.CONTENT , AU.USER_NM AS ANSR_USER_NM , DATE_FORMAT(R.CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS CREATE_DT FROM TB_INQ_ANSR R JOIN TB_INQ A ON A.INQ_ID = R.INQ_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = A.CRTR_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER AU ON AU.USER_ID = R.ANSR_USER_ID WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND R.USE_YN = 'Y'
ORDER BY R.INQ_ID, R.CREATE_DT ASC, R.ANSR_ID ASC

/* 문의하기 관리 기능 권한 보유 사용자 목록 조회 (알림 수신자) inq.selectInqManagerUserIdList */ SELECT DISTINCT UR.USER_ID FROM TB_USER_ROLE UR INNER JOIN TB_ROLE_GRP G ON G.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID AND G.USE_YN = 'Y' INNER JOIN TB_ROLE_MENU RM ON RM.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID AND RM.FUNC_YN = 'Y' INNER JOIN TB_MENU M ON M.MENU_ID = RM.MENU_ID AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND M.SRC_PATH = #{menuPath} INNER JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = UR.USER_ID AND U.USE_YN = 'Y'

/* 문의사항 단건 조회 inq.selectInq */ SELECT A.INQ_ID , A.TITLE , A.CONTENT , A.CAT_CD , C.CODE_NM AS CAT_NM , A.AGENT_ID , G.AGENT_NM , A.STATUS_CD , S.CODE_NM AS STATUS_NM , A.SECRET_YN , A.PIN_YN , A.USE_YN , A.CRTR_ID , U.USER_NM AS CRTR_NM , DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT , DATE_FORMAT(A.MODIFY_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS MODIFY_DT , IF(EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TB_INQ_ANSR R WHERE R.INQ_ID = A.INQ_ID AND R.DEPTH = 1 AND R.USE_YN = 'Y'), 'Y', 'N') AS ANSWER_YN FROM TB_INQ A LEFT JOIN TB_CODE C ON C.CODE_GRP_ID = 'IS000002' AND C.CODE_ID = A.CAT_CD LEFT JOIN TB_CODE S ON S.CODE_GRP_ID = 'IS000001' AND S.CODE_ID = A.STATUS_CD LEFT JOIN TB_AGT G ON G.AGENT_ID = A.AGENT_ID LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = A.CRTR_ID WHERE A.INQ_ID = #{inqId} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.update: /* 문의사항 삭제(논리) inq.deleteInq */ UPDATE TB_INQ SET USE_YN = 'N' , MODIFY_DT = NOW() WHERE INQ_ID = #{inqId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.select: /* 문의 답변·댓글 목록 조회 inq.selectInqAnsrList */ SELECT A.ANSR_ID , A.INQ_ID , A.UP_ANSR_ID , A.CONTENT , A.ANSR_USER_ID , U.USER_NM AS ANSR_USER_NM , A.DEPTH , A.SORT_ORD , DATE_FORMAT(A.CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS CREATE_DT , DATE_FORMAT(A.MODIFY_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS MODIFY_DT FROM TB_INQ_ANSR A LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = A.ANSR_USER_ID WHERE A.INQ_ID = #{inqId} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.CREATE_DT ASC, A.ANSR_ID ASC
/* 문의 답변·댓글 단건 조회 inq.selectInqAnsr */ SELECT A.ANSR_ID , A.INQ_ID , A.UP_ANSR_ID , A.CONTENT , A.ANSR_USER_ID , A.DEPTH , A.SORT_ORD FROM TB_INQ_ANSR A WHERE A.ANSR_ID = #{ansrId} AND A.USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.update: /* 문의 답변·댓글 삭제(논리) inq.deleteInqAnsr */ UPDATE TB_INQ_ANSR SET USE_YN = 'N' , MODIFY_DT = NOW() WHERE ANSR_ID = #{ansrId} AND USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.select: /* 문의 첨부파일 목록 조회 inq.selectInqFileList */ SELECT INQ_FILE_ID , INQ_ID , FILE_PATH , FILE_NM , FILE_SIZE , FILE_TYPE FROM TB_INQ_FILE WHERE INQ_ID = #{inqId} ORDER BY CREATE_DT ASC, INQ_FILE_ID ASC
/* 문의 첨부파일 단건 조회 inq.selectInqFile */ SELECT INQ_FILE_ID , INQ_ID , FILE_PATH , FILE_NM , FILE_SIZE , FILE_TYPE FROM TB_INQ_FILE WHERE INQ_FILE_ID = #{inqFileId}
/* 공통코드 목록 조회 inq.selectInqCodeList */ SELECT CODE_ID , CODE_NM FROM TB_CODE WHERE CODE_GRP_ID = #{codeGrpId} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORD, CODE_ID
